rationale: After the complete identity architecture, BFF proposal, Company OS derivation and repository cleanup were committed and pushed, the owner requested a handoff and continuation with the next piece. This authorizes the next minimum-sufficient identity slice: audit the current Cloud Run Tandem Identity, Mac Mini Company OS and available Google/Cloudflare/Tailscale connectivity boundaries; compare standard service-to-service authentication mechanisms; select the smallest real endpoint topology; and implement only a network-free or isolated disposable runtime proof after the required operational-obligation checkpoint and fresh necessity review. It authorizes clean isolated source worktrees, focused/full verification, bounded independent review when the auth/identity risk gate is met, and commit/push of reviewed source. It does not authorize creating or exposing a production endpoint, loading or rotating credentials, Secret Manager changes, Cloudflare/Tailscale/Google IAM mutations, real network delivery, real users, production identity bindings, Party/ref/access/enrollment/entitlement/customer/provider writes, deployment, activation or migration.
source_task: Owner instruction in Codex: handoff and let's continue with the next piece.
